ex_ante_pressure.description: A dimensionless projected admission-pressure indicator. It is an ex-ante engineering predictor, not an operational outcome.

operational_outcomes.description: Stochastic simulation outcomes use separately defined service, queue, shedding, exposure, throughput, and recovery criteria.

timeseries.description: A bounded representative replication for visual exploration; aggregate outcomes remain based on every declared replication.

admission_profiles.description: Admissions are distributed across the planned admission window.
admission_profiles.label: Gradual admission

admission_profiles.description: The planned population change is requested at the start of the window.
admission_profiles.label: Immediate admission

admission_profiles.description: Admissions arrive in deterministic bursts within the planned window.
admission_profiles.label: Bursty admission

capacity_cases.description: Notional resource capacity is 80 percent of the proportionally provisioned baseline fixture for the target fleet size.
capacity_cases.label: Constrained capacity

capacity_cases.description: Notional resource capacity uses the proportionally provisioned baseline engineering fixture for the target fleet size.
capacity_cases.label: Baseline capacity

capacity_cases.description: Notional resource capacity is 125 percent of the proportionally provisioned baseline fixture for the target fleet size.
capacity_cases.label: Expanded capacity

limitations: All values are generated from notional synthetic engineering fixtures.
The pack is not observed operational evidence or external validation.
The scenarios do not authorize deployment or provide fleet-sizing advice.
Comparisons are model behavior under declared assumptions, not field predictions.
Each resource capacity is recomputed from target fleet size before the capacity-case multiplier is applied; cross-fleet comparisons use proportional provisioning rather than fixed capacity.
No disturbance profile is applied to the linear, immediate, or bursty admission cases.
The 16 fixed-seed replications provide descriptive sample summaries only; no confidence, credible, prediction, or transfer interval is claimed.
title: Fleet assurance synthetic scenario explorer
